data.name: Zuleika
data.long_meaning: The name Zuleika is derived from the Arabic language, and it means 'Rose in bloom'. It is a beautiful and evocative name, suggesting the fragility and beauty of the rose, as well as the promise of new growth and renewal. In Christian tradition, the rose is a symbol of the resurrection and the virgin Mary, making the name Zuleika particularly meaningful for Christian parents.
